## RawLog interface

Normalized EVM log emitted by a single simulated call. The shape is the common subset both backends (`eth_simulateV1` via viem and Tenderly RPC) produce after schema validation. Returned indirectly via `SimulationCall.logs` and consumed by the SDK's transfer parser.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface RawLog
```
